title: Monotonic stack: the next warmer day

steps.caption: Daily Temperatures: days waiting for a warmer day sit on a stack. Their temperatures always decrease from bottom to top.
Day 0 is 73°. Not warmer than the top, so nothing resolves. Push day 0.
Day 1 is 74°. It's warmer than the waiting days on top: day 0 (73°) waited 1. Push day 1.
Day 2 is 75°. It's warmer than the waiting days on top: day 1 (74°) waited 1. Push day 2.
Day 3 is 71°. Not warmer than the top, so nothing resolves. Push day 3.
Day 4 is 69°. Not warmer than the top, so nothing resolves. Push day 4.
Day 5 is 72°. It's warmer than the waiting days on top: day 4 (69°) waited 1; day 3 (71°) waited 2. Push day 5.
Day 6 is 76°. It's warmer than the waiting days on top: day 5 (72°) waited 1; day 2 (75°) waited 4. Push day 6.
Day 7 is 73°. Not warmer than the top, so nothing resolves. Push day 7.
Days still on the stack never got warmer: 0. Every day is pushed once and popped at most once: O(n).
